action.command: cd /tmp && CP=$(grep -o 'name="csrf-token" content="[^"]*"' nf.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*content="//;s/"//'); echo "csrf_len=${#CP}"; grep -o 'name="proposal\[[^]]*\]"' nf.html | sort -u | head; echo "=== form action ==="; grep -oE '<form[^>]*action="[^"]*"' nf.html | head

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp && CP=$(grep -o 'name=\"csrf-token\" content=\"[^\"]*\"' nf.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*content=\"//;s/\"//'); echo \"csrf_len=${#CP}\"; grep -o 'name=\"proposal\\[[^]]*\\]\"' nf.html | sort -u | head; echo \"=== form action ===\"; grep -oE '<form[^>]*action=\"[^\"]*\"' nf.html | head", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Inspect proposal form fields"}
